prompt:
[Animation Style]

3D cartoon rendering in a chibi / Q-version cute aesthetic. Soft subsurface scattering (SSS) on skin for a porcelain-smooth, slightly translucent look. Advanced fur simulation: the black areas of the onesie use short, dense micro-plush fibers; the white belly area uses longer, fluffier pile that deforms and wobbles naturally with body movement. The pale pink scarf has a realistic knit-cashmere texture with fine weave detail. Soft global illumination with a warm-cool contrast — warm key light on the character, cool blue ambient bounce from the snow. Gentle depth-of-field, cinematic but cozy atmosphere. Render quality: high-fidelity CGI, Pixar-adjacent polish, no outline strokes, no flat shading.

[Expression Control]

Facial expressions stay subtle and restrained throughout the first half of the video. The smile is always a gentle closed-lip smile with only slightly upturned corners — never a wide grin, never an open-mouth laugh, never bared teeth in the opening seconds. The mouth stays small and soft; any laugh or giggle is conveyed through the eyes and a quiet closed-mouth smile rather than a large open mouth. Full happy expressions are saved for the second half and remain modest.

[Character Reference]

Reference the character from <图片1>: large brown-red eyes, black blunt bangs bob-cut hair, round face with soft pink cheek blush, small penguin hair clip at the hairline. Full-body black penguin mascot onesie with white long-pile belly fur, yellow beak and round eyes on the hood. Pale pink cashmere scarf wrapped around the neck with the tail end draping naturally. Yellow penguin-flipper shoes. Do NOT use the pure white background or three-view layout from the reference image.

[Subject & Consistency]

A single chibi girl (approx. 2.5 head-body ratio, rounded silhouette) wearing the complete penguin onesie outfit. Maintain the onesie structure, plush material differentiation, pink scarf color, and flipper shoes throughout. Only one character on screen at all times.

[Scene]

A small natural ice slide formed on a gentle slope in a snowy forest clearing. The slope is about 2 meters long, covered with a smooth, glossy ice surface that catches warm sunlight. Soft snow banks pile up at the bottom of the slope like a cushion. Bare trees with snow-dusted branches frame the scene. Gentle snowfall throughout. Cool blue-white snow tones with warm golden sunlight filtering through the trees, creating sparkling highlights on the ice.

[Dialogue & Sound Design]

Girl's voice: young, soft, cheerful, slightly breathy child-like voice; speaks in Chinese.

Environment: light wind, snow compressing, ice cracking softly, distant birdsong.

BGM: playful pizzicato strings with a light glockenspiel, mischievous but warm, low volume throughout.

[Timeline — Total 10s]

0.0s – 2.5s — Tiptoeing to the edge

She appears at the top of the slope holding the two edges of her pink scarf in her hands, tiptoeing cautiously to the edge of the ice slide. She peeks down at the slope, tilting her head side to side with a small, gentle closed-lip smile, her mouth relaxed and barely curved, corners only slightly turned up, her penguin hood's beak bobbing. She puts one flipper-shoe foot on the ice to test it, then pulls it back quickly with a quiet, closed-mouth giggle.
Girl (playful, teasing herself): 「咦——有点滑耶？嘿嘿～」
Sound: soft tiptoe steps, a small squeak of fabric, light "eek" of surprise, playful pizzicato begins.
Camera: low-angle wide shot from the bottom of the slope looking up at her, snowflakes drifting between camera and character. Warm rim light outlines her silhouette.

2.5s – 5.0s — The penguin waddle launch

She turns around, does a little penguin waddle to build momentum, arms flapping like tiny flippers at her sides, a calm focused expression and a small relaxed smile on her face, then spins back and launches herself belly-first onto the ice slide. The white long-pile belly fur flattens against the glossy ice as she lands. She kicks her flipper-shoe feet for extra push-off.
Girl (bright, cheerful but soft): 「企鹅式冲鸭——！」
Sound: padding waddle steps, a soft thump as she lands on her belly, ice skittering, BGM anticipation builds.
Camera: side profile tracking shot at her level, capturing the waddle-to-launch motion, shallow depth-of-field on snow-dusted trees.

5.0s – 7.5s — Sliding with a twist

She slides down fast, gaining speed, wind rippling the long white belly fur backward. She spreads her arms wide, then suddenly does a 180-degree spin on the ice mid-slide, ending up sliding backwards on her belly. Her pink scarf whips up into a swirling arc behind her. She lets out a warm, gentle laugh, eyes curving into a soft happy smile.
Girl (laughing softly): 「哇啊——转圈圈啦！嘿嘿～」
Sound: smooth ice glide, whooshing wind, spinning fabric, light laughter. BGM peaks with cheerful energy.
Camera: fast tracking shot alongside her through the spin, motion blur on background trees, sparkling ice spray trailing her.

7.5s – 10.0s — Triumphant penguin bow

She slides into the soft snow bank at the bottom, which puffs up into a gentle powder cloud around her. She pops up to a sitting position, snow dust on her hood and scarf, then raises both flipper arms overhead in a gentle victory pose. She dusts snow off her belly, then looks straight at the camera with a warm, modest smile and gives a tiny happy bow.
Girl (proud, cheerful): 「企鹅大胜利！嘿嘿～」
Sound: soft impact into snow, powder poof, a satisfied exhale, light giggles. BGM resolves into a warm playful chord and fades gently.
Camera: low-angle medium shot from the snow bank, looking slightly up at her gentle victory pose. Warm key light on her face, cheek blush visible, snow sparkles in the air. Final frame holds on her calm, happy smile with the ice slide behind her in soft focus.

[Consistency Lock]

Keep the girl's identity and count (single character only), penguin onesie material and structure (short black plush + long white belly pile), scarf color and knit texture, flipper-shoe appearance, and the snowy forest ice-slide scene consistent across all time segments. No extra characters, no costume changes, no style shifts mid-video. Voice remains the same young soft cheerful tone throughout.
